notes: Sunday is the shop-and-batch-cook day: the salmon bowls and the lentil stew are both made then and cover four days. Thursday through Saturday are cooked fresh. Three fatty-fish meals clear the two-per-week floor, and every meal leans on turmeric, ginger, or garlic in cooking amounts. No tree nuts appear anywhere this week — seeds and sesame paste do that job instead.
